topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students, introduces complement, and frames the topic's difficulty and importance within immunology.

topics.label: Fundamentals and Core Principles of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the foundational organization, nomenclature conventions, and central role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of Complement Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct recognition pathways that converge to activate C3 on pathogen surfaces.

topics.label: Effector Mechanisms of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the primary downstream mechanisms through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and stimulates immunity.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement Activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins host cells deploy to prevent unintended complement-mediated damage to self tissues.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct pathological consequences and disease presentations resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the diverse molecular strategies evolved by microbes to counteract and evade complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture on complement and previews the upcoming lecture on the adaptive immune system.
